stem: At Thistledown Freight, a teammate adds one brand-new `module` block to an already-initialized configuration and reruns `terraform init` with no extra flags; nothing else in the configuration changed. What happens to the modules that were already installed?

choices.text: Terraform re-downloads every module's source code from the beginning
Terraform ignores the new module block entirely until `-upgrade` is passed
Terraform deletes and recreates the dependency lock file from nothing
Terraform leaves them exactly as they were and only retrieves the new module's source

rationale: A plain re-run installs the sources for modules newly added to configuration but does not change modules already installed. Re-downloading everything contradicts that partial behavior. A plain re-run still picks up the new module without needing `-upgrade`; that flag governs providers moving to newer versions, not whether a new module is installed at all. The lock file is not wiped by a plain re-run.
